notes.title: Looking for translators!
notes.content:
If you want and can help this game with a translation into your native language, then write in the comments!
Activation key and name / nickname in the game are provided!

[b]Upd 05 jan 2018 [/b]
Also see this discussion for details - http://steamcommunity.com/app/768300/discussions/0/1621726179569053008/

The game has translations:
[list]
[*] English
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] Portuguese
[*] Estonian
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Czech
[*] Dutch
[*] Spanish
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Swedish
[*] Italian
[*] Polish
[*] French
[*] Belarusian
[*] Turkish
[*] Portuguese-Brazil
[/list]
Looking for: Arabic, Greek, Japanese, Norwegian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, Korean
